description: This is a Flutter Dart source file defining the LobbyScreen widget for an online lobby feature. It manages UI elements for creating, joining, navigating, and refreshing lobbies, interfacing with an OnlineSessionProvider for backend interactions.

classes.name: LobbyScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the online lobby screen, allowing users to create, join, and navigate through lobby pages.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the LobbyScreen widget.

methods.name: _refresh
methods.description: Fetches the list of available lobbies from the provider and updates the UI.

methods.name: _nextPage
methods.description: Increments the page number and refreshes the lobby list.

methods.name: _prevPage
methods.description: Decrements the page number within bounds and refreshes the lobby list.
